Forged in Sheffield since 1947.

We make chisels, planes, and marking gauges the slow way: drop-forged high-carbon steel, hand-ground bevels, and beech handles turned in our own workshop. No subscriptions. No app. Just tools that outlive their owner.

What we still do by hand

Every blade is hardened, tempered, and tested against a brass rod before it leaves the bench. If it chips in normal use within ten years, we re-grind it for free.
